name: Floppy Fish
author: Chris Breece
description: A small arcade game starring a fish, the author's very first WASM-4 creation, written in AssemblyScript.

descriptions.en: A small arcade game starring a fish, the author's very first WASM-4 creation, written in AssemblyScript.
descriptions.it: Un piccolo gioco arcade con protagonista un pesce, il primissimo titolo WASM-4 del suo autore, scritto in AssemblyScript.
